cover.title:
工具结果还没进模型
就先被截掉一大批
cover.dek: 有人跑了 720 次 harness，发现 11,189 条工具结果里有 3,827 条在进入模型之前就被截断。模型读到的上下文，可能早就被管线剪过一遍。
cover.title_en:
Tool results get cut
before the model sees them
cover.dek_en: Across 720 harness runs, researchers found 3,827 of 11,189 tool results were truncated before reaching the model. What the model reads may already have been trimmed by the pipeline.
